feature: Add relative time and duration formatters to i18n
workflow_rationale: This is a simple workflow because it involves a single package (@xala/i18n), has a small scope (adding two new formatter functions), and requires no coordination with other services. The formatter pattern already exists in the codebase and just needs to be implemented in the i18n package.

phases.name: Core Formatter Implementation
phases.description: Create the core formatter functions (formatRelativeTime and formatDuration) with locale support

implementation_notes: Use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat API for locale-aware formatting
Support both past and future times ('2 hours ago', 'in 3 days')
Accept locale parameter (nb or en)
Handle edge cases (just now, invalid dates)
Follow pattern from client-sdk/utils/date-utils.ts lines 92-111
subtasks.notes: Created formatters.ts with formatRelativeTime function. The function uses Intl.RelativeTimeFormat API for locale-aware formatting, supports both past and future times, accepts a locale parameter (default 'nb-NO'), and handles edge cases like invalid dates. Typecheck passed successfully.

implementation_notes: Support multiple duration formats: compact ('1h 30m'), long ('1 hour 30 minutes')
Accept duration in milliseconds or seconds
Locale-aware labels (Norwegian: 't/timer/minutter', English: 'h/hours/minutes')
Handle zero and negative durations gracefully
Reference archived/client-sdk/src/utils/format.ts line 202
subtasks.notes: Added formatDuration function to formatters.ts. The function supports multiple duration formats (compact: '1t 30m' and long: '1 time 30 minutter'), accepts duration in milliseconds or seconds, provides locale-aware labels for Norwegian and English, handles zero and negative durations gracefully, and includes comprehensive JSDoc documentation with examples. Typecheck passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Add TypeScript type definitions for formatters
implementation_notes: Add FormatRelativeTimeOptions type (with style: 'long' | 'short' | 'narrow')
Add FormatDurationOptions type (with style: 'compact' | 'long', units: array)
Add formatter function signatures to exports
subtasks.notes: Added TypeScript type definitions for formatters including FormatRelativeTimeOptions (with style: 'long' | 'short' | 'narrow'), FormatDurationOptions (with style: 'compact' | 'long', unit, locale), and function type signatures (FormatRelativeTimeFunction, FormatDurationFunction). All types follow existing patterns in types.ts. Typecheck passed successfully with no errors.

phases.name: React Hooks Integration
phases.description: Create React hooks that use the i18n context for locale-aware formatting

implementation_notes: useFormatRelativeTime returns a memoized formatter function that uses current locale
useFormatDuration returns a memoized formatter function that uses current locale
Both hooks should use useI18n() to access the current locale
Use useCallback for memoization to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Follow the pattern of existing hooks (useT, useLocale)
subtasks.notes: Added useFormatRelativeTime and useFormatDuration hooks to packages/i18n/src/hooks.ts. Both hooks use useCallback for memoization, access current locale from i18n context, and follow the existing hook patterns (useT, useLocale). Locale conversion is handled automatically (nb -> nb-NO, en -> en-US). Typecheck passed successfully with no errors.

phases.name: Public API Exports
phases.description: Export formatters and hooks from the package index

subtasks.description: Export formatters and hooks from index.ts
implementation_notes: Export formatRelativeTime and formatDuration functions from './formatters'
Export useFormatRelativeTime and useFormatDuration from './hooks'
Export type definitions (FormatRelativeTimeOptions, FormatDurationOptions)
Follow the existing export pattern in index.ts
subtasks.notes: Added exports to packages/i18n/src/index.ts for formatRelativeTime and formatDuration functions from './formatters', useFormatRelativeTime and useFormatDuration hooks from './hooks', and type definitions (FormatRelativeTimeOptions, FormatDurationOptions, FormatRelativeTimeFunction, FormatDurationFunction) from './types'. Followed existing export pattern in the file. Build succeeded with no errors.

phases.name: Unit Tests
phases.description: Add comprehensive unit tests for formatters

implementation_notes: Test formatRelativeTime: past times, future times, edge cases (now, invalid)
Test formatDuration: various durations, different formats, zero/negative values
Test locale switching (nb vs en)
Test with different options (style variations)
Use vitest as the test framework (already configured in monorepo)
subtasks.notes: Created formatters.test.ts with comprehensive test coverage. 59 tests pass successfully covering formatRelativeTime (past/future times, edge cases, locale switching) and formatDuration (various durations, compact/long formats, zero/negative values, input unit handling). Updated vitest.config.ts to include i18n package tests in the test suite. Verified all tests pass with the command: cd packages/i18n && pnpm -w run test formatters.test.ts

implementation_notes: Add function descriptions

subtasks.notes: Enhanced JSDoc comments in hooks.ts with detailed descriptions, @returns tags, @example tags, and @throws tags. Verified formatters.ts already had comprehensive documentation following the pattern from date-utils.ts.
